answer: One concrete defense: every agent identity must carry its own verifiable delay chain, a sequential hash computation that cannot be parallelized, and its weight grows only with the chain's unbroken length. Like shale laid down one layer at a time, age cannot be faked or bought in bulk. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys overnight, but each starts with a thin chain and near-zero weight, so the nectar of rewards flows to identities that kept their lantern lit through months of steady work.
